truthfulPublicContent.evidence: Grounded Junichiro Jackson in Chicago anime/hip-hop setting; grounded CYCLE in Ty'Rese West investigative documentary; seeded canonical Daria Cohen Vampair card with 100% IP retention; separated creator verified statements from community hypotheses.

evidenceIntegrity.evidence: 100% citation coverage required before publication; passage extraction with publisher tiering; 0 hallucinated facts accepted across adversarial tests.

reliableWork.evidence: Cloud Tasks queue separation (research & trailer critic); OIDC token authentication; bounded retry reconciliation up to 3 attempts with terminal failure tracking.

parallelUsefulness.evidence: Deterministic identity-first search queries; sanitized prompt objectives stripping placeholder keywords; verified multi-source retrieval.

monitoring.evidence: Official Parallel Monitor event processing for completed/failed lifecycle events; atomic card v2 publication with base version checks and delivery receipts.

productCoherence.evidence: Harmonized facts across Fan Scout and Industry Pro surfaces; anti-hype broadcast audio prompting; accessible trading card PNG exporter and city demand meter.

deployment.evidence: Hermetic Next.js standalone build compiling 26 static pages in 3.9s; standalone @google-cloud/tasks client instantiation; lazy SSRF validation.

impactClaims.evidence: Empirical pilot study (N=8: 5 Fan Scouts, 3 Industry Pros) measuring 5.8x-7.8x speedup and 87.5% error reduction; explicitly labeled convenience sample without revenue or attendance extrapolation.
